additional_requirements: The binge eating and inappropriate compensatory behaviors both occur, on average, at least once a week for 3 months

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.

subtypes.Fear of Weight Gain: Extreme fear and loathing of gaining weight or becoming fat.
subtypes.Fear of Specific Foods: Fear that eating high-calorie foods will immediately lead to weight gain.
subtypes.Obsession with Weight Gain: Compulsively checking the scale and becoming extremely anxious about even the slightest increase.

S047.name: Compensatory_Behavior_NonPurging
S047.description: Recurrent inappropriate compensatory behaviors to prevent weight gain without purging (direct removal of food).

subtypes.Fasting: Intentionally stopping food intake for a certain period to prevent weight gain.
subtypes.Excessive Exercise: Repetitively performing exercise at a level that exceeds physical limits to prevent weight gain.

S048.name: Compensatory_Behavior_Purging
S048.description: Recurrent inappropriate compensatory behaviors involving the expulsion of food or fluids to prevent weight gain.

subtypes.Self-Induced Vomiting: Intentionally inducing vomiting to remove ingested food.
subtypes.Misuse of Medications: Repetitively misusing laxatives, diuretics, or enemas for the purpose of weight control.

S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
examples: Eating more than 3-4 times the amount of a typical meal within 2 hours.
Continuously eating large amounts of high-calorie snacks in addition to main meals.
Eating enough to empty a significant portion of the refrigerator or pantry at once.
Eating clearly more food than others during the same period of time.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
examples: A feeling that once I start eating, I cannot stop even if I want to.
Thinking 'I shouldn't eat any more' but mechanically continuing to eat.
A feeling of helplessness that I cannot decide for myself how much to eat.
Eating as if my body is being controlled by someone else.

info.persona: Adam Combs, a 40‑year‑old entertainment attendant, balances a restless curiosity and love for community gatherings with chronic worry, and they often misplace their keys.
info.professional_persona: Adam Combs, an entertainment attendant in Tuolumne County's tourism scene, blends practical curiosity with outgoing energy to troubleshoot rides, read guest needs, and mentor younger staff, while they eye a shift‑lead promotion and a future boutique event‑planning venture.
info.cultural_background: Adam is a White American whose family roots trace back to early twentieth‑century Midwest migrants who settled in the Sierra foothills of California. Raised in the small, close‑knit town of Jamestown, he absorbed a blend of traditional American values—hard work, community participation, and modesty—mixed with the region’s gold‑rush heritage and outdoor lifestyle. His upbringing in a working‑class household emphasized the importance of helping neighbors, celebrating local festivals, and respecting the natural environment around the Sierra Nevada. This cultural backdrop informs his cooperative nature and his commitment to fostering community spirit through entertainment and events.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Adam’s downtime reflects his blend of curiosity, sociability, and need for stress relief. He regularly hikes the Sierra foothills, cataloguing scenery with his camera, satisfying his practical curiosity about the natural world. Music serves as a social outlet; he plays acoustic guitar at local jam sessions and enjoys attending live folk and bluegrass concerts. He volunteers with the Jamestown historical society, helping organize community fairs and theater productions, and enjoys crafting DIY decorations for events. Group activities like pick‑up basketball games and board‑game nights keep his energetic side active, while he practices short mindfulness meditation sessions to manage his stress.
info.sports_persona: Adam Combs, an avid weekend hiker of the Sierra foothills and pick‑up basketball player at the Tuolumne County Community Center, roots for the San Francisco 49ers and the Golden State Warriors while they stay fit through trail runs and occasional yoga sessions.
info.arts_persona: Adam Combs, a folk‑and‑bluegrass enthusiast who strums acoustic guitar at local jam sessions, regularly admires the music of The Avett Brothers, Alison Krauss, and the storytelling of Johnny Cash, and they enjoy cinema classics starring Robert Redford.
info.travel_persona: Adam Combs, an adventurous but budget‑conscious traveler, prefers road‑trip itineraries that pit the pine‑scented trails of Yosemite and the red rocks of Sedona against occasional overseas escapes to Kyoto, while they plan most trips on a mix of spontaneous spur‑of‑the‑moment decisions and a half‑filled spreadsheet of must‑see spots.
info.culinary_persona: Adam Combs, a moderately skilled home cook, loves firing up grilled trout with lemon‑herb butter, tossing a hearty campfire chili peppered with black beans and cumin, and experimenting with sourdough starter and wild mushroom risotto, yet they often forget to defrost meat in time, leading to last‑minute take‑out orders.

info.persona: Linda Miller, a compassionate optician who blends a love for art, gardening, and community service with a relaxed, occasionally chaotic schedule, channels curiosity into low‑vision care while quietly defying strict planning through spontaneous quilt projects and impromptu road trips.
info.professional_persona: Linda Miller, a seasoned dispensing optician with deep expertise in ocular anatomy, optical physics and modern lens technology, blends meticulous prescription verification and custom frame styling with a relaxed, sometimes chaotic workflow, using their compassionate communication to educate patients while occasionally misplacing a spare frame or juggling inventory tasks at the last minute.
info.cultural_background: Linda is a proud African American woman whose roots run deep in Greensboro’s historic Black community. Growing up amid the city’s civil‑rights legacy, she was inspired by her grandparents’ activism and the vibrant traditions of Southern Black churches. Her cultural identity is expressed through soul food cooking, gospel music, and participation in local Juneteenth celebrations. Linda values representation in healthcare, often sharing her journey to encourage other Black youths to pursue STEM careers, and she remains actively involved in a regional sorority that supports mentorship and community service.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In her free time, Linda indulges in her love of art and visual storytelling, often exploring the Greensboro Museum of Art and capturing the region’s landscapes through photography. She enjoys quiet afternoons reading historical fiction about African American experiences, tending to her vegetable garden, and knitting quilts that reflect her heritage. Small‑group gatherings like book clubs, gospel sing‑alongs, and local jazz concerts provide her with community connection while honoring her preference for intimate settings.
info.sports_persona: Linda Miller enjoys cheering on the Greensboro Grasshoppers and the Charlotte Hornets on game nights, participates in a local walking club for low‑impact fitness, and takes up gentle golf outings in the fall, preferring community and leisure over competitive sports.
info.arts_persona: Linda Miller immerses themselves in visual storytelling by frequenting the Greensboro Museum of Art to study works by Jacob Lawrence and Romare Bearden, captures regional landscapes through photography, knits quilts echoing gospel hymn patterns, and attends jazz concerts featuring the sounds of John Coltrane and local saxophonist Emile O., all while occasionally leaving a half‑finished quilt on the couch.
info.travel_persona: Linda Miller prefers intimate, small‑group travel, having explored Savannah’s historic district and the vibrant markets of Accra, while dreaming of a relaxed road trip along the Blue Ridge Parkway in the fall, always planning with a flexible itinerary that leaves room for spontaneous stops.
info.culinary_persona: Linda Miller delights in preparing soul‑food classics such as collard greens simmered with smoked turkey, sweet potato pie spiced with cinnamon, and a signature gumbo seasoned with okra and filé powder, often harvesting fresh vegetables from their garden and balancing smoky and sweet flavors with meticulous care.

info.persona: Thomas Davenport is a competitive yet skeptical retiree who channels intense curiosity and anxiety into gardening, DIY projects, and relentless self-documentation, often battling a habit of over-committing to every new hobby while forgetting to rest.
info.professional_persona: Thomas Davenport, a retired handyman-turned-community garden mentor, blends his practical repair skills and gardening expertise with a curious, competitive spirit that drives them to organize DIY workshops and meticulously document each project on their emerging blog.
info.cultural_background: Thomas grew up as a White American in the post‑World War II era, experiencing the optimism of the 1950s and the social shifts of the 1960s. Raised in a middle‑class, Protestant household, he values self‑reliance, community involvement, and a respect for tradition. Relocating to Florida in his later years, he has embraced the Sunshine State’s retiree culture, blending his love of classic American music, baseball, and community service with an openness to new ideas. His cultural identity is rooted in classic Americana while remaining adaptable to contemporary influences.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Thomas balances solitary and social activities that satisfy his curiosity and competitive streak. He spends mornings tending to his garden, experimenting with new plant varieties and occasional hydroponic setups. Fishing trips on the Intracoastal Waterway provide calm reflection, while bird‑watching lets him appreciate the local ecosystem. He enjoys wood carving, reading historical and mystery novels, and listening to classic rock from his youth. Socially, he participates in bridge games at the senior center, joins a senior golf league, and attends local historical society meetings, where his competitive nature shines through in friendly tournaments and debates.
info.sports_persona: Thomas Davenport enjoys weekend rounds at the Lake Worth Golf Club's senior league, casts his line for sailfish on the Intracoastal Waterway, and avidly follows the Miami Dolphins, Tampa Bay Rays and Orlando Magic, cheering them on while competing in bridge tournaments that feel like a mental sport.
info.arts_persona: Thomas Davenport finds creative release carving wooden figurines while listening to classic rock legends like Led Zeppelin, The Rolling Stones, and Fleetwood Mac, and spends evenings immersing themselves in mystery novels by Agatha Christie and historical sagas by Ken Follett, often quoting favorite passages at senior center gatherings.
info.travel_persona: Thomas Davenport prefers meticulously planned road trips to historic coastal towns such as St. Augustine and Savannah, occasionally indulges in a leisurely cruise through the Caribbean, but their anxiety about unfamiliar airports keeps international travel to a handful of well-researched destinations like Lisbon and Kyoto.
info.culinary_persona: Thomas Davenport delights in cooking hearty comfort dishes like chicken pot pie, shrimp and grits, and apple crumble, frequently incorporating fresh tomatoes, basil, and zucchini from their garden, yet they admit a stubborn reluctance to experiment with spicy cuisines, opting instead for familiar flavors.
